text: In 1979 a group of young counsellors arrive to reopen Camp Crystal Lake, where a boy drowned in 1957 and two counsellors were murdered the following year. As a thunderstorm rolls in, an unseen killer [picks them off one by one|threat|people who kill], leaving [a body pinned to a door with arrows|images|weapons and tools]. Alice, the last of them, meets Mrs. Voorhees, a middle-aged woman claiming to be a family friend, who [blames the counsellors for her son's death|wants|revenge for a wrong], and the lake [still seems to hold something|images|water and drowning].
